unique_selling_points: Combines 60W fast charging with 480Mbps data transfer in a braided, bend-resistant cable for everyday use.
top_features: 60W fast charging delivers up to 20V 3A for rapid power delivery
480Mbps high-speed data transfer enables quick file syncing
Braided jacket withstands over 10,000 bends for long-term durability
Ergonomic ring connector ensures easy and secure connection
Universal compatibility with smartphones, tablets, and laptops
